question.text: Which categories, techniques, and projects are gaining real momentum, what mechanisms explain the change, and what does the acceleration predict next?
question.scope: maintenance momentum by curated category within the 463,221-edge GitHub corpus

claim.position: Agent infrastructure is where maintenance effort is concentrating: agent-memory-store (74.4%), agent-extension-pack (70.5%) and agent-ecosystem-artifact (69.9%) sit far above the 44.8% corpus baseline for repos pushed in 2025-2026, while ml-paper-impl sits below it at 34.9% — so attention appears to be moving from reproducing published research toward building durable agent tooling, rather than AI activity rising uniformly.

dispute.finding: The claim's population cannot be reproduced from any database on this machine. Its metrics file names no source (source: null) and carries no derivations block, so nothing re-derived it until now.

checks.corpus_baseline: REPRODUCES EXACTLY. 463,221 edges with pushed_at, 207,329 recent, 44.8% — re-derived from people_v2.sqlite.
checks.gh_category_field: ABSENT. The caveat cites a "curated gh_category taxonomy"; that key appears in none of the 38 meta_json keys in people_v2, and 0 rows mention these category slugs.
checks.taxonomy_located: A real curated taxonomy exists in foundry-data/domains/github/identity/identity.sqlite (category + repo_category, 385,964 rows) — a DIFFERENT database than the metric implies.
checks.counts_disagree: agent-memory-store: claim says 929 repos, taxonomy holds 181. agent-extension-pack: claim says 17,538, taxonomy holds 3,052.
checks.recompute_blocked: repo_observation has no pushed_at column, so pct_recent cannot be recomputed from the taxonomy at all.

dispute.verdict: The headline ordering (agent infrastructure above baseline, ml-paper-impl below) is neither confirmed nor refuted — it is UNVERIFIABLE as recorded. Confidence dropped from 0.62 to 0.15: the single number that reproduces is the baseline the comparison is measured against, not the comparison itself.
dispute.remedy: Whoever produced 2026-08-04-gq005-category-momentum.json must name the database and add a derivations block. Until then this claim must not inform any decision.

source.title: Category momentum, measured from the people graph
Category momentum, measured from the people graph

action.description: None yet. This is a directional reading of one corpus, not a basis for investment. It would become actionable if the same ordering held on a second signal — adoption or dependents rather than maintenance — which the graph can support but I have not measured.
